title: Loop (automation)
description: profiles/<slug>/loops/<id>.json: an automation, a check script (loops/<id>.sh, pinned by scriptHash) the board runs on a timer without Claude; each new item it finds becomes a ticket. Type Loop in src/core/types.ts; written by Store.saveLoop (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename) from src/schedules/loops.ts. The current format is version 2: Loops.create writes every field below (partOf too, null for none; allowedTools null). Only the fields every version has are required: a file with an older version (an early test format, which may lack fields such as passes) or a newer one is shown as unsupported and left alone. Unknown fields must be kept.

version.description: Format of this file (FORMAT in loops.ts, now 2). Another version: unsupported, never run or rewritten (it can only be switched off).

id.description: 8 base36 chars (newId). Equals the file name without .json.

service.description: Display name of what it watches (e.g. Linear), at most 60 chars; 'a script' when nothing better is known.

passes.description: Ids of board passes (automation-passes.json) its script may use.

scriptHash.description: sha256 (hex) of the script when the user saved it: a script changed since then doesn't run.

column.description: LoopColumn: where its tickets go. planning and ready need autoStart.

autoStart.description: The user switched on that its tickets start Claude by themselves.

askClaude.description: Claude looks at each new item first (a side call with no tools) and decides whether it needs a ticket.

instructions.description: Ticket description with {{title}}, {{link}}, {{service}}; at most 8000 chars.

allowedTools.description: The tools `ckanban call` may use, learned from the first check after a save that calls tools. Null (or [] from older versions): not learned yet.

lastError.description: Why the last check failed (cleared by the next good one).

partOf.description: A main ticket's id or one of its groups': each new ticket goes there as a task. Null or missing: its own card.
